description: This PHP source file defines the DateValue class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functionality to convert date strings into Excel serial date values or PHP DateTime objects. It includes methods to parse date strings, handle different formats and regional settings, and return appropriately formatted date representations.

classes.name: DateValue
classes.description: A class providing static methods to parse date strings and convert them into Excel serial date values or PHP DateTime objects within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: fromString
methods.description: Converts a date string or array of date strings into an Excel serial date value, PHP date/time serial value, or PHP DateTime object. Handles parsing, format adjustments, and edge cases for date conversion.

methods.name: t1ToString
methods.description: Helper method to process two-part date representations, determining whether they denote date or time and constructing a date string accordingly.

methods.name: setUpArray
methods.description: Parses a date string into an array of date components, attempting different formats if initial parsing fails.

methods.name: finalResults
methods.description: Generates the final date value, either as an Excel serial number, PHP date/time, or error, based on parsing success and validation.
